scope: Supplemental-data validation and uncalibrated existing-proxy diagnostics; no new replication implemented.
schema_checks: All 15 satisfy date,adjusted_price; finite positive levels; unique ascending dates; matching metadata. Four Swinkels monthly level series have continuous month-end dates and reproduce the workbook cached monthly returns.

nav_diagnostic_sample.method: Each series sampled at its last available valuation in each calendar month; valuation-date mismatches remain, no calibration to NAV.
nav_diagnostic_sample.limitation: Short in-sample historical diagnostic, not validation of long-run fidelity. Official NAV has no 2026-08-31 observation; last August valuation is 2026-08-28. Index month-end observations may represent later markets.

yahoo_candidate_quality_flags: 2561.T returned two observations before its February 2020 listing. These were explicitly excluded; saved series begins 2020-02-26.

EXHB.DE and EXHD.DE adjusted prices show approximately -3.63% and -3.52% on 2009-05-15. These are investigation flags, not proven errors. Do not interpolate, delete or winsorize without an issuer distribution/NAV reconciliation.

IGLT.L Yahoo adjusted-close calendar 2025 return is approximately 4.73%, versus 5.1% rounded official issuer NAV performance. Different prices/valuation dates or adjustments require reconciliation before treating it as official total return.
ETF files are research candidates, not certified official NAV total-return histories.
